text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all the support last year.
I'm
looking forward to working with you
this year too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...There. Got the formal greeting out of
the way.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Young lady"? What are you, one of my

grandparents?
choice_data_list: You've really got your act together.
You've really got your act togethe...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I grew up surrounded by adults, so they
were
always lecturing me about my
manners and
greetings.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You've been my trainer for a while too,
so I just
wanted to do things right.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and about my New Year's
resolution...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah, but...
choice_data_list: Did you come up with something?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, actually, why don't you share yours
first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The New Year's resolution I set for us
is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oho... You wanna make sure every part
of our
training has a purpose, huh?
choice_data_list: Let's always stay mindful while tr...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Really considering the effects and stuff,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Nice Nature already has a
grasp of how training affects her
progress. She is a smart
girl, after all. In
that case...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's a very peculiar way of saying
"think
harder." But yeah, I'll do as you
say.
choice_data_list: You can think through this even mo...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And trust me, my mind will go as deep
as it needs
to go. I'll figure out your
game in no time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After discussing my New Year's
resolution, I have
another thing I have to
talk to her about.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: A better diet?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I already pay attention to my diet,
though. I'm a
young athlete, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Urk! H-how did you know about that?
choice_data_list: What about snacking in the shoppin...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the shop owners are so nice and
give me
food! There's no way I can reject
that kindness.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So please, Trainer! Is there any way you
could
ignore the snacking part?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uuuuugh, noooo!
choice_data_list: Only if you have a lighter dinner ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After discussing my New Year's
resolution, I have
another thing I have to
talk to her about.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aw, geez, here we go... New tricks?
Stand out?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm no good at any of that. That stuff's
only for
naturally talented people.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... I guess, but I can't help
cringing at those
phrases.
choice_data_list: Still, that'll become a weapon uni...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: A secret weapon, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well,
I've got a year. I'll keep an eye out
for
things that could potentially work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After discussing my New Year's
resolution, I have
another thing I have to
talk to her about.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ummm... Trainer? What did you just say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio is the strongest of her
generation. Though earlier than
expected, Nice Nature will
face off
against her in an open race.
choice_data_list: Tokai Teio is running in the 'Waka...
Tokai Teio is running in the 'Waka...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Geez... I was hoping I just misheard...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm joining that race to show everyone
what I can
do... Ugh, why did Teio have
to join?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're my trainer! Of course, you'd say
that!
choice_data_list: We've got a chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Urghhh,
I guess I really have to do this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can see she's still wrestling with her
feelings but has accepted the reality of
the situation. As long
as we keep
training, I'm sure we can win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By the way...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You want me to tell you now?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Umm... Uh... Soooo, my resolution is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Top.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Urgh! To slide on up to the top!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Don't get the wrong idea! I wasn't the
one who
came up with this resolution!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I went to the shopping district the other
day to say hi to people, and I happened
to mention that
I didn't have a New
Year's resolution yet.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone teased me into making an epic

resolution!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So it's like...
I set that as mine just to go
along
with it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I can't! It's impossible!
choice_data_list: We're gonna breeze to victory in t...
Let's breeze to victory in the nex...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I knew I shouldn't have said anything!
